interpretive_limits: These region and extent summaries are post hoc descriptive re-aggregations of saved predictions.
Region contrasts do not identify a geographic transfer penalty because composition, support, training size, and fitted-fold/retained-full models differ.
Similar ensemble performance would not establish that pretraining contributes no information.
Presence versus effort-supported unrecorded background is not occupancy or verified absence; species and regions are not iid replicates.

scope.aggregation: equal eligible strata per target, then equal target; outer region summaries exclude NULL explicitly
scope.response_state: re-reading already-opened accepted outer responses; no new unsealing
scope.seed_average: float64 mean per fold before AUC
